newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up in volatile market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up in volatile market.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated widely before closing up on Thursday amid a rise in demand for funds and a special open market operation (OMO) by the central bank, dealers said.

Overnight funds were initially traded at 15 to 16 percent as the market was bullish on the OMO, one dealer said. But news that the State (central) Bank of Pakistan had picked up only a small amount depressed rates to around 14 percent, he said.
However, borrowing pressure re-emerged and rates went up to reach 19 percent at the close of the day.
